title: Staff Backend Engineer (.NET) (f/m/d)
description:
Staff Backend Engineer – Platform
 Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech
 Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.
 If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you.
 About the role
 You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there.
 We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in.
 What you'll be up to
 Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems.
 Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently.
 Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment.
 Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders.
 Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence.
 Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably.

title: Produktmanager Snack (m/w/d)
description:
Gestalten Sie unser Snack-Sortiment von morgen!
 Bäcker Görtz steht mit rund 260 Filialen für handwerkliche Backkultur und frische Snacks – jeden Tag, für tausende Kundinnen und Kunden in der Region.
 Unser Snack-Geschäft wächst – und Sie sollen es künftig aktiv mitgestalten und weiterentwickeln.
 Ihre Mission: Sie machen unser Snack-Sortiment zur ersten Wahl in der Region: kreativ, marktorientiert und wirtschaftlich erfolgreich.
 Ihre Vorteile
 Eine Schlüsselposition mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum.
 Kurze Entscheidungswege und einen direkten Draht zur Geschäfts- und Verkaufsleitung.
 Eine attraktive Vergütung sowie einen Dienstwagen.
 Personalrabatt auf unser gesamtes Sortiment.
 Ein motiviertes Team, das Snacks genauso liebt wie Sie.
 Einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz in einem wachsenden regionalen Familienunternehmen.
 Ihre Aufgaben
 Sortimentsverantwortung: Sie entwickeln unser Snack-Sortiment strategisch weiter – von belegten Brötchen über warme Snacks bis hin zu saisonalen Aktionen.
 Produktentwicklung: Sie kreieren neue Snack-Produkte von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung in unseren Filialen und optimieren kontinuierlich bestehende Artikel.
 Präsentation: Sie stellen Ihre Produktkonzepte überzeugend in unseren Entscheidungsrunden vor – inklusive Verkostung, Kalkulation und fundierter Marktargumentation.
 Schnittstellenarbeit: Sie arbeiten eng mit unserem Marketing (Produktmanagement, Werbung), dem Einkauf (Rohstoffe, Konditionen) sowie unserem Backhaus (Produktion, Umsetzbarkeit) zusammen.
 Training vor Ort: Sie schulen und trainieren unsere Filialteams direkt am Point of Sale, damit jeder Snack in höchster Qualität bei unseren Kundinnen und Kunden ankommt.
 Führung: Sie führen und entwickeln ein Team von zwei Snack-Beauftragten.
 Ihr Profil
 Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Lebensmittelbereich (z. B. Bäcker/in, Konditor/in, Koch/Köchin, Fachkraft für Systemgastronomie) oder ein Studium der Lebensmitteltechnologie bzw. Ökotrophologie. Auch Querein…

title: Werkstudent*in Information Security Awareness & Automation

 eigene Themen mit eigener Verantwortung . Du arbeitest nicht auf Zuruf, sondern bringst proaktiv eigene Ideen ein.
 eine Aufgabe, in der Kommunikation zählt: Wir übersetzen komplexe Themen in verständliche Sprache.

title: Senior Implementation Specialist Digital Analytics (w/m/d)
description:
Your new team: As an Implementation Specialist, you are right at the heart of our projects: You translate business requirements into robust technical tracking solutions, implement them, ensure their quality, and turn concepts into fully functioning digital analytics setups. You take full responsibility for digital analytics implementations from initial requirements through to go-live and act as a trusted advisor to our clients throughout the process.
 What awaits you: You analyze our clients’ requirements and translate business and analytics use cases into technically sound tracking and implementation concepts. You develop and document tracking concepts, data models, and data layer requirements and align them with clients and developers. You work with tag management systems, implement tracking and third-party tags, and ensure scalable data collection. You conduct technical testing, debugging, and data validation and systematically investigate data quality issues. You consider consent management, data protection, and technical requirements from the very beginning of the implementation process. You work closely with Digital Analysts, Data Engineers, and Project Managers, acting as the technical interface between business and development. You actively share your expertise within your team and help develop our standards, best practices, and ways of working. Depending on the project, you may also support tool selection, architecture decisions, migrations, and the technical enablement of our clients.
 What you can expect: At FELD M, you won’t work within a traditional agency structure with rigid specializations. We bring together different disciplines and perspectives and see ourselves as The Data Collective.
 You will have the opportunity to work with a diverse range of clients, industries, and technology setups while continuously expanding your expertise. We deliberately work independently of specific tools while bringing many years of expertise and strong partnerships…
